video_title: Mitch Johnson on What To Improve Upon and Spurs Finding Their Balance

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on late-game execution and defensive lapses against Portland
quotes.excerpt: They took advantage of quite a bit of miscues that we had defensively.
quotes.quote: In the final two minutes we had three turnovers, so that's going to be hard. We've been pretty good late-game execution. They do a great job pressuring the ball, so that hurt us. They made some shots. They took advantage of quite a bit of miscues that we had defensively, and even in stretches where we were guarding pretty well, if we had a miscue, they took advantage of it quite a bit. I think that led to them getting some threes. Minus 27, I believe, in the three-point, that's going to be tough to overcome. You got to do some good things around that. They won the opportunity battle, so you're in a pretty big uphill climb if you just put those two things in the recipe.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson points to late game turnovers and a significant deficit in three point shooting as the primary reasons for the loss to Portland

structured.context: Mitch Johnson discusses the team's late-game execution and defensive errors during a loss to the Portland Trail Blazers.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on balancing Victor Wembanyama's usage in traffic
quotes.excerpt: There's so many things that we do, whether it's in transition or at the end of the game.
quotes.quote: There's so many things that we do, whether it's in transition or at the end of the game in a walk-up like that where decision-making is in a bang-bang, a lot of things going on. We try to help prepare our guys for what they may see, and based on what they see, we want them to make decisions accordingly. There's a lot of things happening in that, so it's just stuff that we'll continue to improve upon and clean up.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson says the Spurs are focused on improving decision making and cleaning up execution during high pressure situations in transition and late game sets

structured.context: Mitch Johnson addresses the team's approach to decision-making and ball security when Victor Wembanyama is navigating traffic.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on team competitiveness and reckless fouls
quotes.excerpt: We had some reckless fouls. You let Lillard get 10 and Little get eight attempts.
quotes.quote: I thought our guys' competitiveness was great tonight. Again, like I said, minus 27 from three. We had some reckless fouls. You let Lillard get 10 and Little get eight attempts, so that's 20 attempts from them. We lost the turnover battle. There's a lot of things there that would suggest it's going to be hard to win that game. So we obviously did some good things and a whole bunch of stuff to clean up.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson credits the team for their competitiveness but notes that reckless fouls and losing the turnover battle made it too difficult to overcome the deficit

structured.context: Mitch Johnson evaluates the team's competitiveness and criticizes the reckless fouls committed against Damian Lillard and Nassir Little.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Keldon Johnson and Luke Samanic's rebounding effort
quotes.excerpt: I thought Keldon and Luke provided a good amount of trying to get some extra opportunities for us.
quotes.quote: I thought Keldon and Luke provided a good amount of trying to get some extra opportunities for us. We didn't seem to capitalize on all of them, but I thought again, I thought the fight was there. We just got to be a little bit sharper with some of the execution stuff.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson praises the effort from Keldon Johnson and Luke Samanic on the glass but emphasizes the need for better execution on second chance opportunities

structured.context: Mitch Johnson comments on the rebounding effort provided by Keldon Johnson and Luka Samanic during the game.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Devin Vassell's shooting performance
quotes.excerpt: Devin is doing so much good. We just got to keep getting him shots.
quotes.quote: Devin is doing so much good. We just got to keep getting him shots and putting him in actions to continue to allow him to be aggressive and find his groove.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson says the coaching staff is committed to keeping Devin Vassell aggressive and finding him more shots to help him find his groove

structured.context: Mitch Johnson discusses the need to continue finding shots for Devin Vassell to help him find his rhythm.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama's poise against physical defenses
quotes.excerpt: I thought he did a great job of just not being rushed through the physicality.
quotes.quote: I thought he did a great job of just not being rushed through the physicality. They have a lot of guys with switchable size that try to speed you up, be physical, get underneath. They switch their style at times and put the bigs on him and send doubles. I just thought he did a phenomenal job of just playing at his own pace and making good decisions.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson says Victor Wembanyama did a phenomenal job of playing at his own pace and making good decisions despite the physical defensive pressure and double teams

structured.context: Mitch Johnson praises Victor Wembanyama for maintaining his composure and pace against the physical defensive pressure applied by the opponent.
